name: Louis Franco
source:
A longtime acquaintance of Kyle. He used to be a pickpocket, but those days are behind him. At the moment he's working as a bellhop and bartender at Hotel Dusk. 

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Louis_DeNonno]wiki[/url]]
